trigger: A request names a feature but the user problem or evidence is unclear.
required_output: Problem statement, affected users, evidence gaps, smallest learning experiment.
handoff: product-shaping once the problem is sufficiently understood; product-strategy only for strategic choices.

trigger: Business direction, target market, or investment focus is contested.
required_output: Recommended focus, economic assumptions, opportunity cost, reversal evidence.
handoff: product-roadmapping-and-portfolio for competing investments; product-shaping for a selected opportunity.

trigger: Several worthwhile initiatives exceed available capacity.
required_output: Capacity-feasible portfolio, deferred work, deadlines, benefit confidence.
handoff: product-shaping then implementation-planning for funded work.

trigger: A useful outcome is known but the requested solution is too broad.
required_output: Small release, appetite, exclusions, essential constraints, stopping rule.
handoff: software-architecture if design choices are consequential; otherwise implementation-planning or direct implementation.

trigger: An existing system's boundaries, ownership, or coupling are uncertain.
required_output: Evidence-backed current-state map with unknowns explicitly marked.
handoff: software-architecture for design; systematic-debugging for a defect; performance-optimization for performance.

trigger: A consequential structural choice, rewrite, or service split is proposed.
required_output: One recommendation, credible alternatives, tradeoffs, reversible first step, revisit triggers.
handoff: architecture-decision-records for durable rationale; selected specialist; implementation-planning for delivery.

trigger: A new technology, vendor, or platform standard is being considered.
required_output: Adopt/trial/assess/hold recommendation, cost and exit analysis, bounded experiment.
handoff: software-architecture for system implications; architecture-decision-records when a durable decision is made.

trigger: A significant choice will constrain future engineers or is costly to reverse.
required_output: Short decision record: context, choice, rejected options, consequences, revisit trigger.
handoff: implementation-planning and implementation; update the record only when the decision changes.

trigger: Correctness, coupling, state ownership, retries, or unnecessary abstractions need judgment.
required_output: Explicit invariants and the smallest implementation that preserves them.
handoff: test-driven-development for meaningful regression cases; code-review-excellence for review.

trigger: A public API, event contract, or client-visible representation changes.
required_output: Precise contract, consumer inventory, compatibility strategy, deprecation conditions.
handoff: database-migration if storage changes; verification-methodology for semantic checks; deployment-pipeline-design for rollout.

trigger: Tenant isolation, shared resources, or enterprise isolation promises change.
required_output: Tenant boundaries, enforcement points, placement economics, cross-tenant invariants.
handoff: secure-software-engineering/auth-implementation-patterns for access controls; database-migration for data movement; capacity-and-cost-engineering for resource cost.

trigger: A workflow spans separately committed systems or irreversible business actions.
required_output: Durable states, idempotency, compensation limits, reconciliation and escalation.
handoff: test-driven-development/verification-methodology for failure cases; incident-runbook-templates for operational recovery.

trigger: A schema or stored-data change must coexist with live traffic or old versions.
required_output: Expand/backfill/validate/contract sequence, lock budgets, compatibility and recovery limits.
handoff: verification-methodology before promotion; deployment-pipeline-design for coordinated release.

trigger: A dependency upgrade changes behavior or mitigates a vulnerability.
required_output: Exposure containment, dependency/compatibility analysis, focused upgrade and recovery plan.
handoff: test-driven-development/code-review-excellence for changed behavior; deployment-pipeline-design after relevant verification.

trigger: The change crosses trust boundaries or handles permissions, secrets, or sensitive actions.
required_output: Prioritized threats, server-enforced authorization, negative tests, exposure containment.
handoff: threat-mitigation-mapping for explicit control mapping; auth-implementation-patterns for session design; code-review-excellence/verification-methodology for verification.

trigger: Several identified threats need concrete, testable controls.
required_output: Threat-to-control mapping with residual risk and verification cases.
handoff: secure-software-engineering for implementation; verification-methodology for effectiveness evidence.

trigger: Personal data collection, telemetry, retention, exports, or deletion changes.
required_output: Purpose-limited data model, retention/deletion lifecycle, deletion verification.
handoff: api-design-and-evolution/database-migration for contracts/storage; technical-documentation for operator instructions; verification-methodology for evidence.

trigger: Login, sessions, account linking, revocation, or permission enforcement changes.
required_output: Authentication/session contract, revocation semantics, authorization and CSRF/XSS checks.
handoff: secure-software-engineering for broader exposure review; test-driven-development/verification-methodology for security regressions.

trigger: Work has meaningful sequencing, dependencies, or implementation uncertainty.
required_output: Smallest useful slice, real files/interfaces, owners where needed, checks, recovery and exclusions.
handoff: programming-principles and relevant specialists; technical-program-management only for cross-team dependencies.

trigger: Multiple teams or external dependencies determine delivery.
required_output: Provider/consumer ownership, acceptance evidence, critical path, forecast and escalation decisions.
handoff: implementation-planning for team-level execution; org-design if ownership structure is the recurring bottleneck.

trigger: Authorized delegation can separate independent work with clear file/resource ownership.
required_output: Self-contained task packets, exclusive ownership, integration owner and combined checks.
handoff: code-review-excellence/verification-before-completion after integration; serialize tasks that share mutable state.

trigger: A behavior change or defect merits a regression test.
required_output: Deterministic failing case, minimal fix, observed red/green evidence and relevant edge cases.
handoff: code-review-excellence for review; verification-before-completion for the final evidence claim.

trigger: A defect, failed test, or unexpected behavior lacks an established cause.
required_output: Reproduction, boundary evidence, falsifiable hypothesis, discriminating experiment.
handoff: programming-principles/test-driven-development for the fix; use incident-runbook-templates first if users are currently harmed.

trigger: Latency, throughput, or resource consumption is a measured problem.
required_output: Profile, dominant constraint, one proposed change, comparable benchmark and rollback criteria.
handoff: sql-optimization-patterns if SQL dominates; capacity-and-cost-engineering if capacity dominates; verification-before-completion for measured claims.

trigger: Query plans or database contention show SQL is the bottleneck.
required_output: Plan evidence, focused query/index change, write/storage cost and safe deployment steps.
handoff: database-migration if schema rollout is material; performance-optimization for before/after workload checks.

trigger: A request crosses services or queues and its time/failure location is unclear.
required_output: Trace propagation, async correlation, safe attributes, sampling limits and verification.
handoff: systematic-debugging/performance-optimization to use the evidence; secure-software-engineering/privacy-engineering when telemetry exposes sensitive data.

trigger: A meaningful implementation or design needs correctness review.
required_output: Prioritized findings, reproduction/acceptance evidence, blockers separated from preferences.
handoff: programming-principles/test-driven-development for fixes; receiving-code-review for responding to contested feedback.

trigger: Review feedback is unclear, questionable, or changes scope.
required_output: Technically justified acceptance or pushback and a concrete alternative.
handoff: Implement accepted changes; reverify affected behavior with verification-before-completion.

trigger: Counts or happy-path tests cannot establish semantic correctness.
required_output: Explicit criteria, independent oracle, invariant reconciliation, candidate-bound evidence and verdict.
handoff: database-migration/api-design-and-evolution/saga-orchestration owner resolves discrepancies; verification-before-completion communicates only supported claims.

trigger: About to say done, fixed, tested, migrated, or ready.
required_output: Fresh evidence appropriate to the change; explicit verified, failed, unrun and blocked claims.
handoff: Authorized release via deployment-pipeline-design when applicable, or a truthful completion report.

trigger: A service needs a measurable reliability contract or existing metrics miss user outcomes.
required_output: SLI numerator/denominator, objective/window, error budget and useful alerts.
handoff: site-reliability-engineering for operational policy; deployment-pipeline-design/incident-runbook-templates for rollout and response criteria.

trigger: Reliability risk, alert quality, or error-budget consumption affects a decision.
required_output: User-impact assessment, release recommendation, prioritized reliability work and recovery signals.
handoff: deployment-pipeline-design for release; incident-runbook-templates for incident action; slo-implementation if the measurement contract is missing.

trigger: A production change needs controlled promotion and recovery.
required_output: Verified artifact, preproduction checks, compatible migration order, exposure limits and abort/recovery steps.
handoff: site-reliability-engineering observes outcomes; incident-runbook-templates responds to harm; verification-before-completion limits completion claims.

trigger: A live incident needs immediate action, or a risky path needs a recovery runbook.
required_output: Mitigation sequence, operator/owner, escalation, rollback branch and proof of recovery.
handoff: systematic-debugging during/after stabilization; on-call-handoff-patterns on handoff; postmortem-writing after stabilization.

trigger: Responsibility changes while risk or unfinished operational work remains.
required_output: Named owner, current state, next timed action, escalation threshold and acknowledgment.
handoff: Incoming responder continues incident-runbook-templates; keep uncertain facts explicit.

trigger: An incident has stabilized and lessons need durable follow-through.
required_output: Blameless causal analysis, confidence limits, prioritized owned actions with closure evidence.
handoff: implementation-planning/technical-program-management implement prevention; slo-implementation/incident-runbook-templates update measurement and response.

trigger: Data-loss, disaster recovery, or resilience requirements need demonstrated capability.
required_output: Business recovery scope, RPO/RTO, trusted recovery path and timed restore/integrity evidence.
handoff: database-migration/deployment-pipeline-design for system changes; incident-runbook-templates/technical-documentation for usable recovery instructions.

trigger: Growth, failures, quotas, or infrastructure choices require capacity judgment.
required_output: Demand model, degraded-state capacity, headroom, cost and load/failover validation.
handoff: software-architecture for architecture; deployment-pipeline-design for capacity changes; cost-optimization for efficiency work.

trigger: Cloud spend needs reduction without hidden reliability loss.
required_output: Prioritized savings experiments, measured bill effect, risk controls and rollback.
handoff: capacity-and-cost-engineering checks capacity; site-reliability-engineering protects reliability; verification-before-completion distinguishes estimates from savings.

trigger: An internal platform or shared developer tool needs investment or adoption decisions.
required_output: Validated user bottleneck, small self-service offer, voluntary pilot and outcome/stop criteria.
handoff: product-shaping/implementation-planning deliver the slice; technical-program-management coordinates actual dependencies.

trigger: A change creates a new operator, developer, or consumer task.
required_output: Task-oriented instructions, real examples, failure handling and verification steps.
handoff: incident-runbook-templates/on-call-handoff-patterns for operations; api-design-and-evolution for consumer migrations; verify commands before publication.

trigger: Recurring handoffs and local incentives prevent end-to-end delivery.
required_output: Ownership diagnosis, bounded organizational experiment, decision rights and flow/health measures.
handoff: technical-program-management tracks dependencies during the experiment; product-roadmapping-and-portfolio adjusts displaced commitments.
